l.i: Qui non credit filio, ira Dei manet super eum. Reatus ex vna
offensa introiit ad condemnationem. Eramus natura filij irae.
&c.2. Nam & infantes sunt peccato obnoxij: quia moriuntur.

main_text.l: Non autem ex imitatione habent peccatum: er-
go ex propagatione. Quod etiam scripturae testimoniis
confirmatur. Omne figmentum cogitationum cordis humani

l.i: duntaxat malum est, idque omni tempore. Transgressorem
ex utero vocaui te[?]. Video aliam Legem in membris meis, &c.

main_text.l: Contra hanc autem de peccato originali doctrinam,
olim contenderunt Pelagiani, vt nunc Anabaptistae,

page.notes: Catchword "Scriptura" stands at the lower right and is the first word of the next page; not repeated in the text. Doubtful readings: "vocaui te" (printed form looks like "vocauite"), "singulae" (possibly "singulam"), the mark after "membris" (a small stray dot, omitted). Marginal reference numbers copied as printed; "Ioan. 3. 36." is uncertain in its last digits. Placement of the left-margin references is by vertical alignment with the lines.
